selection_rule.E5_v2A_rule: In the listed order, take the first feasible candidate for each preregistered semantic coverage slot: (A1) relative+compact+auto Circle, (A2) maintain-current+normal+auto with a non-Circle planar geometry, and (A3) relative+spacious+auto Sphere. A candidate is feasible only when validation, center resolution, qualitative scaling, workspace geometry, allocation, hard-safety acceptance, final timing, and profile compilation all accept it under both registered design state models.
selection_rule.E5_v2B_rule: In the listed order, take the first task-family definition that is feasible for all N in [8, 12, 16] without method-semantic changes. S1 uses the first explicit duration from the preregistered grid [8, 10, 12, 14, 16] seconds that remains unchanged by both planning and final dynamic-feasibility gates in every N cell. No ranking by margin is performed.
selection_rule.feasibility_question: Does a legal physical realization exist under the frozen policy?

state_models.audit_rule: Every candidate is checked under both state models. The post-readiness model is the prospective nominal resolver input; formal execution must still log and assess the actual frozen fresh snapshot.

cold_start_spawn.rule: UAV i starts at world [0, 3*i, 0.83] m, as frozen by the PX4 multi-instance launcher.

nominal_post_readiness_snapshot.rule: UAV i is at world [0, 3*i, 1.50] m after the frozen controller startup takeoff/hover gate.
